reason: I might push one client's chat through the free 30 documents just to see it, but a Google Sheet of categories doesn't save me the real work. I still have to re-key every receipt into Jurnal or Accurate with the invoice number, PPN and NPWP, so there's nothing here I can put my name on and resell to clients.
objection: It does not export to Jurnal or Accurate and has no invoice number, VAT (PPN) or NPWP fields, and it's built for one business owner, not a firm with a separate chat for each of twenty-odd clients.
would_change_my_mind: A direct export to Jurnal or Accurate with invoice number, PPN and NPWP pulled out of each receipt, plus one account where I can manage all my client chats and bill them myself at a margin.
